issue_context.title: Bug: Issue with Black Background on Icons and Context Menu in Files
issue_context.body: ### Description I'm experiencing an issue with certain icons having a black background. When I right-click on an item and go to "Send to" in the context menu, some icons have a black background. Additionally, when I right-click on a folder and access its properties, the icon displayed there also has a black background. ### Steps To Reproduce 1. Go to the context menu of an element 2. Click on "Send to" 1. Go to the properties of an folder ### Requirements Conduct extensive testing across different items, folders, and properties to ensure consistent icon appearance and background transparency. ### Files Version 2.5.22.0 ### Windows Version 22H2 22621.1992 ### Log File
comments: Does clearing the icon cache in Windows fix this issue?
No, because I have tried on different computers and this issue persists.
I'm still looking into the content menu, but I have a fix for the properties window.

review_comments: We can define `ThumbnailOptions.ResizeThumbnail` as the default value for `thumbnailOptions` to avoid adding the parameter to each method call.
I'd rather it be explicit as different areas of the codebase use different options.
